text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute approaches me while I'm
packing
up to go home after training.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Would it be okay with you
if I
trained a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah. It's nothing big or anything,
but... well,
take a look.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Come on! Just a bit more!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale... I think I can go a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Their passion is so infectious, I'm getting
riled up
just watching them.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I figure if I'm already feeling warmed up,
it'd be a
shame not to do some running.
What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Really? I'm so glad you get it.
choice_data_list: わかった、もうひと頑張りしよう！
クールダウンも大事だよ
choice_data_list_en: Got it. Let's push a little harder!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go just a little longer, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Wonder Acute uses that heat
to keep
running until the sun goes down.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I understand. I suppose I have done
everything I
needed to today...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I got so carried away by their passion
that I
totally forgot how hard I've
already pushed
myself. That could have
been risky.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's call it here, then. I'll head back and
make
some crunchy munchies to cool
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Wonder Acute and I decide to
call it a
day before she pushes herself
too far.
